title: Disappointment in a box
text: Not what I expected at all. When I opened my first box, I realized this is the best scam ever. My first box contained a small candle, small bag of popcorn, and a a couple of small jigsaw puzzles. Not anything like the cool projects and fun games as advertised. I’m embarrassed to show it to my husband as I know he’ll just laugh. Canceling after my first box. I sincerely hope this is not the box that they send to all first time customers or else they are not going to stay in business very long.
label: negative
